What is Survei Margin Underkeel?

In this glossary, Survei Margin Underkeel refers to: Hydrographic assessment confirming minimum clearance between keel and seabed along planned passage meets safety criteria.

How is Survei Margin Underkeel used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Kantor Hidrografi: Survei margin underkeel selesai; jarak bebas minimum di rute lebih tinggi 1,2 meter di atas UKC yang diperlukan."
